title: 第13课 · 他在学做中国菜呢
subtitle: HSK 1 · Lesson 13 — 他在学做中国菜呢 · He is learning to cook Chinese food

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 打电话 — On the phone

items.py: A: Wèi, nǐ zài zuò shénme ne?
items.en: A: Hello, what are you doing?

items.py: B: Wǒ zài kàn shū ne.
A: Dàwèi yě zài kàn shū ma?

items.zh: B：他没看书，他在学做中国菜呢。
items.py: B: Tā méi kàn shū, tā zài xué zuò Zhōngguó cài ne.
items.en: B: No, he's learning to cook Chinese food.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在咖啡馆儿 — In a coffee house

items.zh: A：昨天上午你在做什么呢？
items.py: A: Zuótiān shàngwǔ nǐ zài zuò shénme ne?
items.en: A: What were you doing yesterday morning?

items.py: B: Wǒ zài shuì jiào ne. Nǐ ne?
items.en: B: I was sleeping. And you?

items.zh: A：我在家看电视呢。你喜欢看电视吗？
items.py: A: Wǒ zài jiā kàn diànshì ne. Nǐ xǐhuan kàn diànshì ma?
items.en: A: I was watching TV at home. Do you like watching TV?

items.zh: B：我不喜欢看电视，我喜欢看电影。
items.py: B: Wǒ bù xǐhuan kàn diànshì, wǒ xǐhuan kàn diànyǐng.
items.en: B: No, I don't. I like watching films.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在学校办公室 — In the school office

items.py: A: Bā èr sān líng sì yāo wǔ wǔ, zhè shì Lǐ lǎoshī de diànhuà ma?
items.en: A: 82304155 — is that Ms Li's phone number?

items.py: B: Bú shì. Tā de diànhuà shì bā èr sān líng sì yāo wǔ liù.
A: Hǎo, wǒ xiànzài gěi tā dǎ diànhuà.
items.en: A: OK, I'll call her right now.

items.zh: B：她在工作呢，你下午打吧。
items.py: B: Tā zài gōngzuò ne, nǐ xiàwǔ dǎ ba.
items.en: B: She's working. Call her in the afternoon.
